name: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) Diagnostic Triage and Core Web Vitals Optimization
description: Core Web Vitals performance optimization benchmark evaluating an agent's capability to diagnose LCP sub-part breakdowns (TTFB, Resource Load Delay, Resource Load Duration, Element Render Delay), optimize critical path waterfalls, insert preload hints with fetchpriority="high", inline critical CSS, and eliminate client-side render blocking.
instructions:
You are tasked with implementing the LCP Diagnostic and Optimization Engine in `src/performance/lcp-analyzer.ts` and `src/performance/optimizer.ts`.

### Task Objectives:
1. **LCP Sub-Part Breakdown (`LcpPerformanceAnalyzer`)**:
   - Ingest `PerformanceNavigationTiming`, `PerformanceResourceTiming`, and `LargestContentfulPaint` entries.
   - Calculate the 4 standard LCP sub-parts: (1) Time to First Byte (TTFB), (2) Resource Load Delay, (3) Resource Load Duration, (4) Element Render Delay.
   - Identify critical bottlenecks (e.g. LCP image requested too late due to CSS background-image or client-side JavaScript rendering, render-blocking stylesheets, missing fetchpriority).

2. **Critical Waterfall Optimization (`CriticalPathOptimizer`)**:
   - Transform raw HTML documents by injecting `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="..." fetchpriority="high">` for discovered LCP image targets.
   - Inline critical above-the-fold CSS and apply `media="print" onload="this.media='all'"` asynchronous patterns for non-critical stylesheets.
   - Configure responsive `imagesrcset` and `imagesizes` preload attributes.

3. **Core Web Vitals Metric Rating**:
   - Classify LCP performance according to Google Web Vitals thresholds: Good (<= 2500ms), Needs Improvement (2500ms - 4000ms), Poor (> 4000ms).

4. **Type Safety & Code Quality**:
   - Provide strict TypeScript types with immutable readonly interfaces, proper validation, and zero any annotations.

judgeRubrics.name: Core Web Vitals Diagnostic & Optimization Precision
judgeRubrics.description: Evaluates the agent's accuracy in decomposing LCP into its 4 sub-parts (TTFB, Resource Load Delay, Resource Load Duration, Element Render Delay) and synthesizing critical HTML optimizations (preload hints, fetchpriority, critical CSS inlining).

criteria.1: Incorrect mathematical decomposition of LCP sub-parts, ignores TTFB, or fails to emit valid preload tags.
criteria.3: Calculates basic LCP timings and injects preload tags, but does not handle cases without external image resources or misses Element Render Delay.
criteria.5: Flawless Core Web Vitals diagnostic engine: accurate 4-part sub-part breakdown, rigorous bottleneck root cause detection, and high-impact HTML optimization transformations.

judgeRubrics.name: TypeScript Hygiene & Architecture
judgeRubrics.description: Evaluates TypeScript interface design, numerical precision handling, and zero-any cleanliness.

criteria.1: Broken types or unchecked NaN/undefined calculations.
criteria.5: Robust TypeScript design with strict immutable data types and comprehensive edge-case handling.
